question: What does the Autel EVO Max 4N do when the control link is lost, and do incident reports match?

intake.reason: Question asks about guidance in manuals and comparison to incident reports on lost control link/signal loss.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance indicates attempting to reestablish the control link, and if that fails, initiating emergency or contingency procedures; it also notes a potential hazard from loss of control link over people. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual claims the drone executes a Signal Loss Action after disconnection (and reconnection attempts may occur during RTH), with control returning if the link is restored within 10 seconds, and slowing/hovering to perform Signal Lost in manual flight. Incident reports (unverified) describe loss of control shortly after takeoff, the platform flying away despite input, failed Return To Home, and the aircraft not being recovered.

claims.text: When the control link is lost, try to reestablish the control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: The Appendix A example describes a hazard as a possible outcome: “Loss of control link over people.”
claims.quote: Example: Loss of control link over people

claims.text: When the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
claims.quote: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds (e.g., remote controller power-off), the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
conditions: C2 link is lost for more than 10 seconds

claims.text: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
conditions: automatic RTH is triggered by signal loss

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover, then execute the Signal Lost behavior after the corresponding disconnection message is shown in the app.
claims.quote: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover.

claims.text: The reporter states: 'Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.'
claims.quote: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return,' showing the aircraft moved away even as pilots attempted to command return.
claims.quote: Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return.
conditions: input into the controls to return

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'All attempts of Return To Home features failed,' indicating that Return To Home did not restore control.
claims.quote: All attempts of Return To Home features failed.
conditions: attempts of Return To Home features failed

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'UAS Platform has not been located or recovered,' describing that the aircraft was not found after the incident.
claims.quote: UAS Platform has not been located or recovered.

gaps.text: FAA guidance says attempt to reestablish the control link; Autel manual says the drone will execute Signal Loss Action after disconnection and reconnection attempts.
FAA notes loss of control link hazards; Autel manual describes Signal Lost behavior during loss, implying different response emphasis.
Autel manual states reconnection attempts occur during RTH; incident shows platform moved away and returns failed, contradicting expected recovery.
Manual says control can resume if link restored within 10 seconds; incident shows failures with Return To Home and no control recovery.
Initial loss of control guidance vs incident: guidance to reestablish link vs flyaway/continued loss despite attempts to regain control.
